name: Tsurugisan Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of Mt. Tsurugi, Shikoku's second-highest peak, with its rocky summit and the Iya valley gorges of western Tokushima.
notes: Managed by Tokushima/Kochi. The Tsurugi ropeway and the Iya vine bridges are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
